description:
Top 10 anime nobles who abused their power and got Karma — the most satisfying corrupt-noble revenge moments in anime, from tensura to One Piece's Celestial Dragons. These arrogant villains thought their authority made them untouchable… until karma hit.
From Eugeo snapping in Sword Art Online's Alicization arc, to Luffy decking a Celestial Dragon, to Rimuru's Megiddo massacre in That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime — we're counting down the most disrespectful, ego-inflated anime nobles who got cooked.

🔥 Which downfall hit YOU the hardest? Drop your pick in the comments!
